prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1060; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give my statement without my name on it, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the file, we'll note you as the claimant. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was backing out slowly. I checked my mirror, but a white pickup was coming down the aisle faster than I expected. We hit on the rear driver's side of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag didn't deploy, but my head snapped forward and hit the steering wheel.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed me with a concussion. I've had headaches, dizziness, and trouble focusing on screens for long periods.

Q: Are you still under a doctor's care for the concussion?

A: Yes. I have a follow-up scheduled, and I've been told to limit reading and driving until my symptoms improve.

Q: Did anyone else witness the accident?

A: I don't think so, but the other driver gave me their insurance information, and I took a few photos of both cars before they were moved.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I want my vehicle repaired and my medical bills covered. I've missed several days of work because of this.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
